rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a casual athletic pullover or sweatshirt.

example.english: I’m wearing a sweatshirt to go running today.
example.traditional: 我今日着住件衛衣去跑步。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 wai6 ji1 heoi3 paau2 bou6

rows.note: Use this for a shirt worn next to the skin to absorb sweat, rather than for an outer pullover.

example.english: When I play ball, I wear a sweatshirt over my undershirt.
example.traditional: 我打波嗰陣，會喺汗衫出面着件衛衣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 bo1 go2 zan6 wui5 hai2 hon6 saam1 ceot1 min6 zoek3 gin6 wai6 ji1
